exposure: placental location (low-lying placenta, placenta previa, anterior component)
cohort: The study included 44,608 patients who delivered by cesarean section at a single institution between January 2011 and May 2024.
finding: Maternal morbidity, including rates of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and hysterectomy, significantly increases with a greater number of successive cesarean deliveries and is exacerbated by anterior placenta previa or anterior low-lying placental location.
mod_finding: Increasing numbers of cesarean deliveries are strongly associated with higher rates of PAS, hysterectomy, blood transfusion, and longer total operative times.
gest_age: Median 38 weeks (interquartile range 37-39 weeks), with gestational age decreasing with increasing number of cesarean deliveries.
